summary: Track 19.16 Phase B1 (Dynamic Field Incident Reporting) — Frontend testing on /incidents/report. Overall the new engine is wired up: 9-card picker, ProgressRail, draft indicator, review section testids, submit-gate label, and route separation (legacy /incidents/new preserved) all pass. However there are FOUR critical testid/behavior deviations from the review spec that block a green end-to-end automated pass and will bite any downstream automation that relies on the documented conventions.

ui_bugs.issue: Yes/No/Unsure option testids do NOT match documented convention. Spec: `incident-report-field-<field_key>-yes|no|unsure`. Actual DOM emits `incident-report-<field_key>-yes|no|unsure` (the `-field-` segment is stripped inside PresenceGate). Confirmed on everyone_safe, ems_needed, hazard_controlled, police_response, etc. The FieldRenderer wrapper (`incident-report-field-<key>`) is correct, but the inner PresenceGate root uses `incident-report-<key>` and its buttons follow suit. This breaks every automated selector in the spec and any external QA harness.

Spec expected `lang-toggle-en` / `lang-toggle-es`; actual DOM uses `lang-toggle` (root), `lang-en`, `lang-es`. Not a functional bug (bilingual switch DOES work — 'Reportar un incidente' shown when ES active), but a testid contract deviation.

Near Miss flow does NOT include an Evidence/Photos step. Steps observed: immediate → location → people → what_happened → near_miss → immediate_actions → notifications → witnesses → review (8 steps, STEP 8/8 = Witnesses). Photo testids (`incident-report-field-photos-input`, `-capture`) are absent everywhere in this flow, and there is no `incident-report-review-step-evidence` card on the review screen. Spec requirement to verify photo capture element attributes cannot be exercised on Near Miss — reviewer should either add evidence to Near Miss or explicitly document that photos live only on the higher-severity flows.

After filling fields on the near_miss steps and reloading /incidents/report: localStorage keys are present (`masci.incident_report.draft.v1.__index__` and `masci.incident_report.draft.v1.dr_<id>`, ~73 bytes payload), and the `incident-report-draft-indicator` badge is visible, BUT the page lands back on the incident-type picker rather than restoring the incident_type + step and previously-entered values. The `incident-report-field-job_number-input` was empty after reload. Draft is being written but not correctly rehydrated into the running form state on mount.
ui_bugs.selector: localStorage keys present but form values not restored on reload

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise the POST /api/incident-cases → transitions → success path because the required yesno_unsure buttons on the immediate step cannot be reached via the spec's documented testids (see PresenceGate bug). With required fields incomplete, Submit stays disabled with the correct label `Complete required fields to submit`. Once the testid drift is corrected the flow should complete. Also attempted with page.route() mocking of the incident-cases endpoints — zero network calls were emitted because the client-side submit was blocked by the same required-field gate.

Either propagate the full tid (including -field-) into PresenceGate's testIdPrefix OR compute the option testIds in IncidentReport.jsx and pass them explicitly via the options[].testId prop as already done for the yesno branch. yesno_unsure branch (line 433-440) needs the same explicit options treatment.

Compare with line 421-432 (yesno branch) which DOES pass explicit options {testId: `${tid}-yes`}, but the buttons for yesno ALSO show up as `incident-report-<key>-yes` (see ems_needed-yes/no in the DOM dump), so the drift is happening even for the explicit-options path. context_for_next_testing_agent: The 4 bugs above are the primary blockers. After the main agent fixes PresenceGate testid propagation (this is a 1-line fix in IncidentReport.jsx or PresenceGate.jsx) and draft restore-on-mount, the entire spec should pass. To exercise the submit path end-to-end, either use page.route() interception (endpoints hit are POST /api/incident-cases, PATCH /api/incident-cases/{id}/field-block, POST /api/incident-cases/{id}/evidence, POST /api/incident-cases/{id}/transitions) OR seed the admin token in localStorage['admin_token'] AND localStorage['masci.admin.token'] via the multi-login call shown in the test credentials. To test photos, use the vehicle_accident or property_damage flow which DO include the evidence step.
rca of the issue: PresenceGate testid drift: In IncidentReport.jsx FieldRenderer, tid is computed as `${testIdPrefix}-${field.key}` where testIdPrefix='incident-report-field'. This tid is used correctly for the FieldRenderer wrapper (`incident-report-field-everyone_safe`). It is also passed as testIdPrefix into PresenceGate. However, the DOM inspection shows PresenceGate emits its root as `incident-report-everyone_safe` (missing `-field-`) and its buttons follow the same pattern. This means PresenceGate is either (a) not receiving the full tid, or (b) stripping '-field-' somewhere. The main agent should trace how testIdPrefix flows through PresenceGate.jsx and either propagate the exact tid or update the schema convention to match reality. Reproduction: navigate to /incidents/report, click any incident-type card, on the Immediate step run `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid*=everyone_safe]')` in the console — you'll see the wrapper has `-field-` but the buttons do not.
